title: Sri Lanka in Serenity: Kandy, Nuwara Eliya and Bentota
alt: A quiet stretch of Bentota beach at first light
transport: Private air conditioned car with an English speaking chauffeur guide throughout

stops.name: Kandy
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 3★ · Deluxe class hotel with views over the Kandy valley

activities.name: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
activities.description: A stop on the way up from the airport to watch the resident herd bathe in the Maha Oya river and feed at the sanctuary.

activities.name: Tooth Relic temple, lake and Kandyan dance
activities.description: The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, a circuit of the lake and the drummers and dancers of the evening show.

program.name: Kandy
program.description: One night above the Kandy valley with the elephants on the way, the Tooth Relic temple and the dance show.

stops.name: Nuwara Eliya
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Hill country hotel among the tea bushes above Nuwara Eliya

activities.name: Nuwara Eliya sightseeing and tea plantation
activities.description: Gregory Lake, Victoria Park, the colonial town and a tea plantation and factory.

program.name: Nuwara Eliya
program.description: Up into the tea country for a night among the bushes with a tour of the town and a plantation.

stops.name: Bentota
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Beachfront hotel at Wadduwa on the way to Bentota

activities.name: Madu River boat
activities.description: A late afternoon boat through the mangrove islands of the Madu Ganga.

activities.name: Bentota sightseeing, turtles, cinnamon and fish spa
activities.description: The Kosgoda turtle hatchery, a cinnamon plantation, the fish pedicure centre and the beach.

program.name: Bentota
program.description: Two nights by the sea with an evening boat on the Madu River and a day of the turtles, the cinnamon plantation and the fish spa.

stops.name: Colombo
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · City hotel a short walk from Galle Face Green

activities.name: Colombo sightseeing tour
activities.description: Galle Face Green, the Gangaramaya temple, the colonial Fort district, the Lotus Tower and the floating market at Pettah.

program.name: Colombo
program.description: A last night in the capital with a tour of its temples, colonial quarter and markets.

day_titles.1: Arrival in Colombo and on to Kandy

1: Arrival at Bandaranaike International and private transfer inland
A stop at the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary on the way
The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic and a circuit of the lake
The Kandyan dance performance and dinner at the hotel
2: Breakfast and a transfer up to Nuwara Eliya
A tea plantation and factory visit on the climb
Gregory Lake, Victoria Park and the colonial town
Check in among the tea bushes
3: Breakfast and a long transfer down from the hills
A late afternoon boat on the Madu River
4: Breakfast, then the Kosgoda turtle hatchery
A cinnamon plantation and the fish pedicure centre
Optional: water sports at the river mouth

Galle Face Green and the Gangaramaya temple complex

expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Kandy, the hills and then the coast. Sri Lanka works best when you let the island cool you down before it warms you up again.
expert.tip: Carry a light sweater for Nuwara Eliya. It sits at nearly 1,900 metres and evenings are surprisingly chilly even in April.

summary: Six unhurried days: a night in Kandy with the elephants, the Tooth Relic temple and the dance show, a night in the tea country, two nights by the sea with the Madu River, the turtles and the cinnamon plantation, and a last night in Colombo.
included: Included: 5 nights in deluxe class hotels with breakfast daily (dinner also on the first night); private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary; the Tooth Relic temple, lake drive and Kandyan dance performance; Nuwara Eliya sightseeing and a tea plantation; the Madu River boat; Bentota sightseeing with the turtle hatchery, cinnamon plantation and fish spa; the Colombo sightseeing tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; lunches and dinners unless stated; entrance tickets; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
